title: Three Charges, One Dose
story_choice: Neutral original capability scene; not a new serial or Ember canon rewrite
purpose: Isolate source-to-beat fidelity, directed action, editability and phone lettering from attachment to current imagery or lore
hypotheses: Correct storyboard-to-source binding removes critical event errors without requiring a new model
Controlled separable shapes/layers improve attention and bounded correction more than full-frame plate finishing
Human-first correction may be needed if neither generated route preserves acting/contact under budget

characters.description: Fictional adult courier, mature long face, short black curls, pale yellow asymmetrical rain cape, fitted charcoal trousers, one plain short staff; no real likeness
characters.silhouette: Narrow cape shoulder, long adult proportions, no armor ornaments

characters.description: Fictional adult keeper, broad adult build, close-cropped silver hair, ultramarine work jacket, cream cuffs; one free hand for shutter release
characters.silhouette: Broad rectangular shoulders, short jacket versus Nera cape

environment: Original flooded observation gallery; west entry left, dry center ridge, east/right exit shutter, one overhead recess. Simple box/camera map before final art. No published settings/designs.
props: one sealed flask in chest sling/hand
one plain short staff, breaks atP12 and stays broken
three-legged slate kite-bodied sentinel with one violet gill slit; no humanoid face, no copied creature

panels.beat: Nera steadies a trembling breath, looking toward the exit light.
panels.continuity_contract: Both adults west of closed exit; flask upright in Odo’s hand; staff intact; charge3.

panels.beat: Odo offers Nera the sealed flask; she asks him to hold the exit.
copy: ODO: One dose. Keep it upright.
panels.continuity_contract: Flask transfers Odo→Nera without opening; Odo turns toward door release.

panels.beat: Wide gallery: west entry left, shallow water center, exit shutter right, overhead dark recess. No monster visible.
panels.continuity_contract: Camera remains south of movement axis; exit screen-right. Adult positions and dry stepping ridge clear. Shutter release is on WEST pillar, linked by overhead cable to EAST shutter; no unexplained teleport to the exit.

panels.beat: Wrist display establishes three charges and one of two verified counters needed to unlock Air Brake; Nera checks flask/staff.
panels.continuity_contract: No activation or resource change. UI occupies clear margin, not hand/face.

panels.beat: A slate kite-bodied three-legged sentinel unfolds from the overhead recess into the east route.
panels.continuity_contract: Reveal top-to-bottom; sentinel east/right, adults west/left; exit occluded by threat.

panels.beat: Nera plants on the dry ridge and lowers the staff; Odo reaches the shutter release from the west side.
panels.continuity_contract: No attack yet; flask fixed to Nera’s chest sling, lid upright.

panels.beat: Sentinel lunges right-to-left; forefoot line crosses the ridge and splashes water.
panels.continuity_contract: Clear silhouette, trajectory and target; no teleport or body doubling.

panels.beat: Nera spends one pulse to brake the forefoot with her staff; bent knees and staff compression show force.
panels.continuity_contract: Foot/staff contact visible. Flask remains upright. This is a temporary stop, not victory. This verified counter completes the two-counter requirement; Air Brake unlocks and stays available.

panels.beat: The sentinel pivots around the blocked foot, sweeping its side limb toward Odo at the release.
panels.continuity_contract: New vector threatens partner; original exit geography re-established. Nera’s first answer is insufficient.

panels.beat: Nera tosses the sealed flask toward Odo’s free hand; reciprocal eyelines make the timing clear.
panels.continuity_contract: One flask follows one visible arc; Odo receives it upright. No duplicate flask.

panels.beat: Nera uses newly unlocked Air Brake to halt her vault above the sweep, then redirect toward contact; Odo pulls the west release cable to raise the east shutter.
panels.continuity_contract: One body and a continuous arc with a visible braking accent; no teleport or duplicate body. Exit rises; Odo begins moving east with flask.

panels.beat: Nera’s staff strikes the sentinel forelimb joint as the shutter opens. The staff breaks at the contact, scraping her hand.
panels.continuity_contract: One visible contact point, counterforce, deformation and broken staff; no effect cloud hiding the event. Odo slips through the raised opening behind the staff strike, flask upright; both adults are moving east.

panels.beat: Beyond the opening, Odo releases the cord so the shutter drops behind both adults and pins the sentinel foreleg on the west side. Nera holds the broken staff.
panels.continuity_contract: Shutter now lowered with foreleg caught under its bottom edge; threat remains alive/west. Both adults east; flask in Odo hand, staff broken, scraped hand, charge1, Air Brake unlocked.

panels.beat: Beyond the door Odo steadies Nera’s scraped hand beside the sealed flask. They breathe, then turn toward the next passage.
panels.continuity_contract: Hold consequence and relationship after spectacle; same injury, broken staff, flask and charge1 remain.

routes.label: Best current directed hybrid
routes.mechanism: Current in-product full-frame source generator plus original reference sheets, exact approved storyboard intent, targeted correction and editable SVG. No inherited wrong-beat sources.

routes.label: Controlled separable modular route
routes.mechanism: Owned thumbnails/layout and character/prop assets constrain separate line/cel character, background and effects passes; conventional redraw/finishing corrects contact/face/hand. Must demonstrate real editable layers, not SVG wrappers around same fused raster.

routes.label: Human-first optional control
routes.mechanism: Skilled sequential artist drives drawing/model sheets/action and finishing; generation used only for a separately verified advantage. Unrun unless real staff/time is available.

attempt_budget.grouping_rule: Freeze any panel group before generation; one group retry counts as retry for every included panel, no hidden split/retry reset. Preserve all failures.

production_prerequisites: Named human editor/action artist and two independent human reviewers available within separately authorized capacity
Freeze same story/copy/layout/camera and assets for all compared routes
Explicit valid tool/reference rights and exact eligible inputs; protected/private/third-party art not uploaded
Agree actual correction-hour ceiling before starting; estimates are not authority to hire

hard: 14 exact beats; no unexplained extra/missing principal actor, state reset, wrong event order, omitted required contact or unexplained prop transfer
All required text visible inside intended balloon/UI shape; zero face/contact occlusion; correct tail attribution
Actual dialogue minimum14CSSpx, UI minimum12CSSpx at390 viewport; these are project floors, not universal standards
Zero missing source assets, broken required links or horizontal overflow; transcript and keyboard navigation
One-to-one provenance and attempt log; candidates remain unaccepted/review-pending/commercially-uncleared until explicit review
human: Two independent human readers each reconstruct >=6 of7 tested action functions (anticipation, attack, counter, reversal, new-skill application, impact, aftermath), all three charge states and the earned unlock without explanatory script; required contact/state hard gates still all pass.

Each human rates sequence and lettering categories >=4/5, art and reader impact >=3.5/5, with every required core dimension assessed and >=3; no selective omission. See required_core_dimensions and permitted_not_assessed.

For absolute eligibility, owner finds the complete route compelling enough to continue; two independent humans pass the absolute rubric/comprehension gates. A may qualify or win. For replacing A with B/C, owner and both independent humans explicitly prefer the replacement complete reader.

For replacing renderer, both human reviewers show >=0.75/5 improvement in sequence or art category, no >=0.5 regression in the other and zero hard defects; if within margin call tie and keep cheaper route
Record all labor; modular route must fit agreed34–74h single-route planning envelope or approved replacement ceiling, never treat agent runtime as human time
kill: Any hard defect remains after one targeted retry plus one bounded correction round
Do not promote B/C without clear preference and improvement sufficient to justify correction burden. An absolutely eligible A survives a tie; any route failing absolute gates stops.
Missing skilled human capacity or destination prohibits the chosen production method
gates.approval_authorizes: Only a bounded Ember micro-opening through the winning route, then at most two separately agreed follow-on episodes for throughput validation; not a ten-chapter production
gates.rejection_teaches: If semantic fidelity fails across routes, revise storyboard/skills; if art wins but owner dislikes neutral story, do not infer Ember rejection; if owner dislikes equally directed Ember despite competent art, compare short new-premise hooks using same route

blind_protocol: Randomized route labels/order, equal390 andfull-size surfaces, same copy/assets/scene; reviewers submit independent dimension scores before discussion. Preserve qualitative reasons, panel flags and hours. Owner can review unblinded after preference lock.
owner_questions: Which complete version feels most compelling to continue, and which exact moment earns that preference?
Where did you lose track of position, force, object ownership or emotional intent?
Which adult character would you want to see again, and why?
Is the remaining objection mainly story desire, character appeal, art finish or reading friction?
preserve: all candidates and failed attempts locally
exact prompts/inputs/provenance fields with null unknowns
actual human timers and incremental spend ledger
phone/full QA and independently submitted preferences
proof_not_results: Static storyboard/lettering proof does not test final drawing quality, generator fidelity, real human correction time, localization or owner preference. No route winner is claimed.
revision_reason: Pre-output red-team review: define shutter closure physics, add earned skill unlock/application, separate absolute route eligibility from comparative replacement. No production or static proof output existed before this revision.
gate_margin_status: The0.75/0.5 ordinal category margins are predeclared conservative project decision rules, not statistically calibrated market thresholds; qualitative reasons and hard cases take priority.

art_direction: absence of generic generated painting signatures

permitted_not_assessed.localization resilience: Synthetic expansion is a layout diagnostic only. Actual translation requires a language-qualified letterer and is unassessed here; do not include in scored category denominator.
permitted_not_assessed.production_fitness: All ten long-run dimensions remain unscored in the short pilot. Record actual editability, attempts, labor, provenance and delivery as evidence/hard requirements; do not invent repeatability or throughput scores.

prospective_anchor_clarification: Generic painting signatures means visible repeated/motiveless detail, weak hierarchy or inconsistent shapes, not painterly medium. Do not reward line/cel automatically. Historical frozen rubric/scores are unchanged.

comprehension_answer_key.answer: P06 Nera plants the staff and waits for the forefoot while Odo reaches the west release.
P07 sentinel forefoot lunges right to left toward Nera on the ridge.
P08 staff visibly stops the foot using one charge, leaving two; second verified counter earns Air Brake.
P09 the sentinel pivots and sweeps a side limb toward Odo; the first counter is insufficient.
P11 newly earned Air Brake halts and redirects the vault above that sweep, costing another charge and leaving one; it enables the changed attack path.
P12 staff contacts forelimb joint and breaks, scraping Nera’s hand; the opening permits both adults to escape east.
P13 cord release lowers the shutter behind both adults and pins a living threat’s foreleg west; Odo retains intact flask, Nera broken staff/injury, one charge remains.

critical_comprehension_rule: The 6/7 threshold may tolerate only a noncritical omission. Wrong actor, target, contact, causal order, resource/unlock reason, escape geography or prop consequence is an absolute failure regardless of numeric score. Ask readers to retell without revealing this key.
gate_clarification_note: Red-team tie, required-core, medium-neutral anchor and answer-key clarifications before any scored production output. V2 story/copy/heights unchanged.
